observed_steps: A private KnowledgeBase with a published Knowledge Revision was exposed through the visibility application and admin review APIs.
A separate ordinary user read the resource while visibility was public.
The owner reduced visibility to private; the same user then received HTTP 404.
Owner resource and revision responses were inspected for provider identity redaction.

knowledge_bases: one private KB with one published revision

limitations: This scenario covers resource visibility and API redaction; the full Gate 8 artifact also requires separate snapshot and failure evidence.
